subject.title: fix(exec-approval): distinguish non-persistable command from ask=always policy in approval prompt

question: Should maintainers repair this focused PR as the canonical fix for https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/97069, or promote a sibling PR with broader renderer coverage and proof instead?
rationale: Multiple open PRs target the same approval-copy bug, and this branch still has concrete renderer gaps plus a contributor proof gate that automation should not resolve on the author's behalf.

options.title: Repair this PR before merge
options.body: Keep this PR open, require native Telegram and generic forwarding coverage plus real prompt proof, then use it as the landing path if maintainers prefer the smaller diff.

options.title: Promote a sibling canonical fix
options.body: If another open sibling already covers the full renderer surface with stronger proof, preserve this PR's useful context there and close this branch only after the canonical path is selected or merged.

recommendation.title: Repair this PR before merge
recommendation.body: Keep this PR open, require native Telegram and generic forwarding coverage plus real prompt proof, then use it as the landing path if maintainers prefer the smaller diff.
